summary: Transform your understanding of climate change with our specialized training. Gain the skills needed to promote sustainability and protect our planet.
lede: Climate and sustainability practice combines emissions measurement, climate-risk assessment, and evidence-based planning. For professionals in sustainability, operations, risk, procurement, finance, or reporting, the course covers setting emissions boundaries and calculating carbon footprints, mapping climate risks, and designing sustainability KPIs and action roadmaps. Exercises use spreadsheets and templates to turn findings into outputs such as a baseline worksheet, risk register, and leadership-ready action plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who already touch sustainability, operations, risk, procurement, finance, or reporting and now need to apply climate and sustainability methods with confidence. It suits you if you must produce practical outputs, support decisions with evidence, or strengthen disclosure readiness across your function.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and a willingness to work with spreadsheets, templates, and simple scenario exercises. Familiarity with sustainability concepts, operational reporting, or risk processes will help you move faster, but no programming or advanced statistics are required.
